name: substack
description: Substack MCP server and CLI for Claude Code and AI agents. 65 tools for drafts, posts, Notes, subscribers, analytics, tags, comments and researching other publications.
long_description:
Connects Claude to a Substack publication you own.

Substack publishes no API, so this calls the same endpoints its own web app calls, signed with your session cookie. There is no OAuth app to register: the setup is your publication URL and the connect.sid cookie from a browser you are already signed in to.

Publishing emails every subscriber and cannot be unsent, so publish_draft, publish_note, every delete and comment_on_post refuse to run without an explicit confirmation.

Four tools need no login at all, so researching other publications works before any setup.

publication_url.title: Your publication
publication_url.description: For example example.substack.com. Leave empty to research other publications only.

session_token.title: Session cookie
session_token.description: The connect.sid value from a browser signed in to Substack. It expires after about 90 days.

read_only.title: Read only
read_only.description: Hide every tool that can publish, schedule, delete or comment.
